concept.name: Gator oscillator
concept.definition: Bill Williams' companion to the Alligator: a dual histogram showing the convergence and divergence of the Alligator's balance lines - the upper histogram is |Jaw - Teeth| and the lower is -|Teeth - Lips| - used to time the 'sleeping, awakening, eating, sated' phases.
concept.intuition: Instead of eyeballing whether the Alligator's mouth is opening or closing, the Gator plots the mouth's spread directly: expanding bars mean feeding, contracting bars mean sleep.
concept.mechanics: Compute the Alligator Jaw, Teeth and Lips (SMMA of the median price, periods 13/8/5 shifted 8/5/3); the top bar is |Jaw - Teeth| above zero and the bottom bar is -|Teeth - Lips| below zero, colored green when larger than the prior bar and red when smaller.
concept.failure_modes: Entirely derived from lagging smoothed averages, so phases are identified late; MotiveWave notes it generates no trading signals of its own - it only visualizes Alligator context.
concept.misconceptions: Green bars on both histograms are not a buy signal by themselves - Williams' phases require alignment with the Alligator's line ordering and price position.
concept.example: With Jaw = 100, Teeth = 101, Lips = 103: upper bar = 1, lower bar = -2; if yesterday's bars were 0.8 and -1.5, both expanded - the gator is 'eating'.
